subject: Re: CIW kickoff — robust training under label noise as a shared component
body:
Pre-sweep checkpoint and one decision.

Decision: Giannis's relaxation fixed the imbalance collapse on the internal set (head-class weight mass down from 91% to 64%, accuracy +2.3 on the tail), so full CICW recipes ship for imbalanced data too. No scope cut needed.

Sweep logistics: config matrix is frozen at 1,920 runs. We start Monday on our vulcan-h100 week — the 512-accelerator reservation for the week of 2026-07-06 — with Emeka running launch and Farah on-call for the results pipeline. Anything that fails twice gets dropped from the matrix rather than re-queued, we have stats headroom.

If all goes to plan we're writing docs by Jul 13 and release on schedule.

Jelena
